title: Chyrp Lite (xenocrat/chyrp-lite) contains a missing brute-force protection vulnerability in the main_login() function…
description: Chyrp Lite contains a vulnerability in its main_login() function due to missing brute-force protection. This flaw allows remote attackers to repeatedly attempt login to the admin account without any lockout, delay, or CAPTCHA, enabling unlimited password guesses via POST requests. Successful exploitation grants full administrative control, including post publishing, user management, and file uploads.
